integrity: The finite computations are supporting checks, not the proof of the infinite formula. All source attributions distinguish prior unweighted results from new weight-resolved statements. No independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only labeled periodic binary words whose entire infinite periodic extensions avoid antisquares of order at least two. No assertion for finite-only avoidance, higher alphabets or arbitrary complement operations; an equivalent weight refinement may exist outside the inspected bibliography.
title: Constant-weight rigidity and exact spectra of circular antisquare-good binary words
